<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Boko Haram insurgency]]
**A [[Boko Haram]] [[female suicide bomber]] kills at least nine civilians in Kaiga-Kindjiria, western [[Chad]]. Two other civilians are injured. [https://www.trtworld.com/africa/suicide-bombing-in-western-chad-kills-at-least-9-33094 (TRT World)]
*[[Yemen Civil War (2015–present)]]
**[[January 2020 Ma'rib attack|2020 Ma'rib attack]]
***The death toll from the [[unmanned combat aerial vehicle|drone]] and missile attack on a [[mosque]] in a [[military training camp]] in [[Ma'rib]], [[Yemen]], has risen to 116. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-51166943 (BBC News)]
*[[2019–2021 Iraqi protests]]
**Four protesters and two [[Iraqi Police|police]] officers are killed during clashes in [[Baghdad]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-iraq-protests/four-protesters-two-policemen-killed-as-iraq-unrest-resumes-idUSKBN1ZJ0QQ (Reuters)]
*A former [[special police officer]] and two [[militants]] are killed during a gun battle with [[Indian military|Indian troops]] in the region of [[Jammu and Kashmir (union territory)|Jammu and Kashmir]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-india-kashmir/former-policeman-among-three-militants-killed-in-gunfight-with-indian-troops-idUSKBN1ZJ186 (Reuters)]

;Health and environment
*[[Phase-out of lightweight plastic bags|Phase-out of plastic bags]]
**[[China]]'s [[National Development and Reform Commission]] announces that single-use [[plastic bag]]s will be banned in major cities by the end of the year, and then nationwide by 2022. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-china-51171491 (BBC News)]
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Mainland China]]
***Chinese premier [[Li Keqiang]] has urged decisive and effective efforts to prevent and control the epidemic. [https://www.chinadaily.com.cn/a/202001/21/WS5e26556ca31012821727269c.html (''China Daily'')]
***The [[National Health Commission]] of China reports a third death from [[coronavirus]], the number of infected having increased by 136 during the weekend. The report comes as authorities confirmed that the virus spread from [[Wuhan]] to major cities, including [[Shenzhen]], [[Beijing]], and [[Hong Kong]]. [https://www.scmp.com/news/china/society/article/3046771/china-coronavirus-wuhan-reports-136-new-cases-over-weekend (''South China Morning Post'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in South Korea]]
***A case of Chinese coronavirus is also confirmed in [[South Korea]]. [https://en.yna.co.kr/view/AEN20200120004500320 (Yonhap News Agency)]
*The fifth-ever case of [[Brazilian hemorrhagic fever]], caused by the [[Sabiá virus]], is reported in [[São Paulo]], [[Brazil]]. The patient visited at least three hospitals in three different cities before the diagnosis was established; [[contact tracing]] is underway. [http://outbreaknewstoday.com/brazilian-hemorrhagic-fever-case-reported-in-sao-paulo-state-69791/ (Outbreak News Today)]
*[[Malaysia]] ships back 3,737 metric tonnes of illegally-imported [[plastic pollution|plastic waste]] to 13 countries as [[Ministry of Energy, Science, Technology, Environment and Climate Change (Malaysia)|Environment Minister]] [[Yeo Bee Yin]] declares that the country "[will] not become the garbage dump of the world". [https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-51176312 (BBC News)]

;International relations
*[[International recognition of the Sahrawi Arab Democratic Republic]]
**[[Bolivia]] withdraws its recognition of the [[Sahrawi Arab Democratic Republic]] as an independent nation, and cuts ties with the ruling [[Polisario Front]]. [http://northafricapost.com/37171-sahara-bolivia-abandons-polisario-separatists-isolation-deepens.html (''The North Africa Post'')]

;Law and crime
*[[Trial of Catalonia independence leaders#Audiencia Nacional|Trial of Catalan police leaders]]
**The trial against the [[Mossos d'Esquadra]] leadership begins in the [[Audiencia Nacional|National Audience]] for the role of the regional police in the [[Catalan independence referendum, 2017|2017 Catalan independence referendum]] and the [[2017–18 Spanish constitutional crisis|2017–18 constitutional crisis]]. Then-Major of the Mossos [[Josep Lluís Trapero Álvarez|Josep Lluís Trapero]], Pere Soler and [[Cèsar Puig]] face 11 years of imprisonment for rebellion, while [[Teresa Laplana]] is accused of [[sedition]], facing four years of imprisonment. [https://www.nytimes.com/aponline/2020/01/20/world/europe/ap-eu-spain-catalonia.html (''The New York Times'')] [http://oklahoman.com/article/feed/10005748/ex-police-chief-on-trial-for-role-in-catalan-secession-bid (''The Oklahoman'')]
*[[2020 VCDL Lobby Day]]
**Thousands of protesters gather in [[Richmond, Virginia|Richmond]] to protest tighter [[gun laws in Virginia|gun laws in the U.S. state of Virginia]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-51180452 (BBC News)]
*[[Crime in Florida]]
**A man is arrested for a series of 40 [[rape in the United States|rapes]] in the [[Miami]], [[Florida]], United States area in the 1980s. [https://www.miamiherald.com/news/local/crime/article239423768.html (''Miami Herald'')]

;Politics and elections
*The draft law on [[2020 amendments to the Constitution of Russia|making amendments to 14 articles of the Constitution of Russia]] was presented by the working group in only five days. The same day [[Russian President]] [[Vladimir Putin]] formally submitted a bill on amendments to the [[State Duma|lower house of parliament]].
